provenance.codes: the loss codes recorded by document.formats import lowering plus the adapter constants
provenance.office: xlsx and pptx keep a format-native read model next to the IR projection because geometry, styles and anchors have no IR carrier, their codes are the constants in src/import/xlsx/model.rs and src/import/pptx/model.rs
provenance.downstream: the same profile / supported / approximated / refused shape as projects/plotter/input-contracts.json
provenance.audit: each acceptance item of 19 / 20 / 21 was mapped to a named test in the adapter readme, the construct tables were checked against the lowering branches, and every claimed supported construct is re-imported and re-rendered from its sample by tests/contracts/mod.rs in each adapter

math_font.installed: formulas are painted as outline paths and the authored source text no longer appears in the svg
math_font.missing: session diagnostics carry `vutex.layout.math.not_typeset` as Error and the formula source stays visible as text
math_font.note: the import adapters never ship a font and never install one, the host decides, so both environments are part of the visible contract
